J1_data_analyst.label: Data Analyst, retail analytics
J1_data_analyst.text:
Data Analyst - Retail Analytics (Bengaluru, 0-2 years)

About the role
Join our analytics team to help store and category managers make better decisions with data.

What you will do
- Write SQL to pull and combine sales, inventory and customer data.
- Build and maintain dashboards in Power BI or Tableau.
- Analyse trends and present clear recommendations to business teams.

Must have
- Strong SQL (joins, aggregations, window functions)
- Advanced Excel
- Power BI or Tableau
- Clear communication of insights

Nice to have
- Python (pandas) for data cleaning
- Retail or e-commerce experience

J2_ml_engineer.label: Machine Learning Engineer, fintech
J2_ml_engineer.text:
Machine Learning Engineer - Fintech (Pune / Remote, 2-5 years)

About the role
Build and run the machine learning models behind our lending and fraud decisions.

What you will do
- Develop models in Python with scikit-learn or PyTorch.
- Deploy models as APIs (FastAPI or Flask) in Docker containers.
- Run them on AWS and monitor performance and data drift.

Must have
- 2+ years building production ML models
- Python, scikit-learn and/or PyTorch
- Docker and REST API deployment
- Cloud experience (AWS preferred)

Nice to have
- MLflow or another MLOps tool
- Credit risk or fraud domain experience
